name: Hard Wall Hop Difficulty Chart Stage Obby
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Hard Wall Hop Difficulty Chart Stage Obby!

Master the Art of Wallhop! This unique obby challenges your skills using the classic Roblox wallhop glitch. Progress through stages with increasing difficulty! 💪 Don't know how to wallhop? Search 'How to Wallhop in Roblox' on YouTube – tons of guides available! The game gets harder and harder as it progresses!

✨ Join the group to unlock Free Skip! https://www.roblox.com/communities/32931518

😃 There are currently 10 unique difficulty levels, featuring a total of 95 challenging stages! 🔥
💀 Stuck too long? Press R to reset instantly and try again faster!

😁 If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to Like & Favorite it really helps!  
Thanks for playing! 👍
